summary: This bill revises and updates Title 51 of the U.S. Code by restating existing law on national and commercial space programs without changing its meaning or effect, redesignating chapters and sections, enacting new sections on topics such as facilities, technology, and human space exploration, and making technical amendments to committee names, cross-references, and other provisions.
